capture_layer_identity: Explicit IDs assigned during the single forward trace; callbacks may arrive in any order

configuration.attribution: oracle(candidate32 incoming dO) - oracle(original64 incoming dO) must explain at least 90% of each failed full-model projection group delta in L2
configuration.case_selection: historical/current failed projection pairs, all heads of layers with failed coefficient bias/amplitude groups, plus layer14/head2 control
configuration.limitation: local replay does not override failed full-model gates; attribution locates error before this block but does not identify the upstream operation responsible
configuration.reference: independent analytic FP64 attention VJP and FP64 reconstruction of tanh/projection; actual FP32 projection VJP measured separately
configuration.repeat_acceptance: exact full gradients; per-leaf differences and original numerical gates reported separately; no unmeasured embedding tolerance
